sync_clock.name: Synchronize Stove Clock
sync_clock.description: Synchronize stove time and date with the current Home Assistant time and date.

set_chrono_program.name: Set chrono program
set_chrono_program.description: Write one chrono (weekly) program in a single request. Fields left out are not changed.

program.name: Program
program.description: Chrono program number (1-4 on most stoves).

start.name: Start
start.description: Start time, rounded down to 10 minutes.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stop time, rounded down to 10 minutes.

power.name: Power
power.description: Power level, within the stove range (0 = Silent on some stoves).

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature, within the stove range.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days on which the program runs. Days left out are switched off.

user.title: Micronova Agua IOT options
user.description: Select `Bluetooth (auto-detect)` to let Home Assistant auto-detect and validate a nearby Micronova BLE module when you submit the form (experimental).

data.air_temp_fix: [Jolly Mec] Ignore incorrect air temperature when using external themostat.
data.reading_error_fix: [Bronpi] Filter incorrect readings (when stove is without power).
